children: Overview
Botswana diamond miner's Q3 revenue rose 19% yr/yr, driven by large stone sales
Company raised 2026 revenue guidance to $140 mln-$160 mln from $100 mln-$130 mln
Adjusted operating earnings rose, but net income declined slightly yr/yr
Outlook
Lucara raises 2026 revenue guidance to $140 mln-$160 mln from $100 mln-$130 mln
Company lowers 2026 operating cost per tonne processed guidance to $24-$26 from $27.50-$31
Company sees tightening supply and price momentum in larger diamond categories supporting outlook
Result Drivers
LARGE STONE SALES - Revenue growth was primarily driven by the sale of the 1,303 carat Type IIa diamond and other large stones
HIGHER THROUGHPUT - Increased plant throughput contributed to lower operating cost per tonne processed
WEAKNESS IN SMALLER DIAMONDS - Lower average prices for smaller stones continued to weigh on revenue from certain sales channels
